@@U03249@@
I never rest.

@@U03251@@
Then take me with you! Please!

@@U03253@@
Jump on up!
Once you're in place on my back,
I can ask you where you're headed?
If it’s ferrying across the river you need,
I’m at your service.

@@U03255@@
(Mounting.)

@@U03256@@
Wherever you like.
I’m eternally grateful to you—
you, the great one, the noble tutor,
who to his glory mentored a race of heroes,
that splendid brotherhood of 阿尔戈英雄们,
and others who created a world for poets to sing of.

@@U03258@@
Let’s forget that, shall we?
Not even 雅典娜 rates very high as a mentor.
In the end they go off, these heroes,
and carry on as if we'd taught them nothing.

@@U03260@@
Here I sit and in my arms embrace,
in body and spirit,
the great physician who knows every herb and root,
healer of the sick and reliever of human pain.

@@U03262@@
If beside me some hero was wounded,
I knew what to do,
where to get help and advice;
but I gave it up in the end, my skills,
and monks and witches’ quackery took it over.
translation:
@@U03249@@
我从不休息。

@@U03251@@
那就带我一起去吧！请！

@@U03253@@
跳起来吧！
当你在我背上就位后
我可以问你要去哪里吗？
如果您需要渡河，
我随时为您服务。

@@U03255@@
（安装。）

@@U03256@@
你喜欢去哪里就去哪里。
我永远感激你——
您，伟大的人，高贵的导师，
为了他的荣耀，他指导了一群英雄，
阿尔戈英雄们的辉煌兄弟情谊，
以及其他创造了一个供诗人歌唱的世界的人。

@@U03258@@
让我们忘记这一点吧？
就连雅典娜作为导师的评价也不是很高。
最终他们离开了，这些英雄，
继续前进，就好像我们什么也没教给他们一样。

@@U03260@@
我坐在这里，在我的怀里拥抱，
在身体和精神上，
认识每一种草药和根的伟大医生，
病人的治愈者和人类痛苦的缓解者。

@@U03262@@
如果我身边有英雄受伤，
我知道该怎么做，
从哪里获得帮助和建议；
但最终我放弃了，我的技能，
僧侣和女巫的庸医接管了它。
